title: Document state token format invariant in SSE event ID computation
description: Lines 293-300 in kithd/src/events.rs compute the SSE event id by extracting the numeric suffix from state tokens (e.g., 's-N' -> N) and taking the max. The unwrap_or(0) comment says 'batch is non-empty but may lack s-N tokens' — this suggests defensive code for malformed tokens, but in practice all StateChange events are generated by code we control (lines 49-52 in message.rs) and always follow the 's-N' format. Clarify the invariant: why is this unwrap_or defensive when the format is guaranteed? Answer the question: could we panic instead, or is there a scenario where batch contains events with malformed state tokens that we want to tolerate gracefully?
